expectations.buyer: AI data-centre developers and operators, utilities, RTOs or ISOs, engineering firms, insurers, and grid-connection programme owners
expectations.pain: Built electrical load ramps, disturbances, backup generation, and control behavior diverge from interconnection promises and threaten energisation or operating permission
expectations.strongestIncumbent: Utility telemetry and SCADA, power-system studies, commissioning agents, relay and power-quality testing, data-centre infrastructure management, and interconnection agreements
expectations.biggestRisk: The utility owns acceptance and telemetry, bespoke engineering may dominate, test data is inaccessible, and few operators may pay for a neutral continuous harness
